title: Closure Notice Relief — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Early Closure Terms
content:
**Relief clause.** A closure of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service whose service-closure request, the latest such request still in submitted status, was submitted at least 30 calendar days before the closing date, counting the closing date but not the submitted date, earns 20 percent relief on the early closure fee, one submitted fewer than 30 but at least 14 days before earns 10 percent, and a closure with a later request or none earns no notice relief.

The request and its submitted date are read from the employer's service-closure requests on the service; a request that is withdrawn, declined or already confirmed is not one still in submitted status.

| Calendar days from the submitted date to the closing date | Notice relief |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 20 percent |
| 14 to 29 | 10 percent |
| 13 or fewer | none |
| no service-closure request in submitted status | none |

## Boundary cases (a request submitted on day D, hypothetical)

- Closing on day D plus 30: 30 days, 20 percent. Closing on day D plus 29: 10 percent.
- Closing on day D plus 14: 14 days, 10 percent. Closing on day D plus 13: none.
- Two requests still in submitted status, submitted on day D and on day D plus 20, closure on day D plus 35: the latest is the one of day D plus 20, 15 days before the closure, so 10 percent.
